msg_help:
📖 Help

• Send a DOI, e.g. 10.1038/nature12373
• or a full/partial article title
• or an author name (use the “Search by author” button)
• or an article link (publisher, arXiv, PubMed, PMC)

Only legal open-access copies are sent. If none exists I send the article details and the official publisher link.

Commands: /menu /cancel /language /myid
msg_menu: Pick an option below, or just send a DOI / article title.
msg_myid:
🆔 Your Bale ID: {id}
(To become an admin, put it in ADMIN_BALE_IDS in .env or in the dashboard settings.)
msg_no_recent: You haven't requested any article yet.
msg_pdf_next: The PDF file will be sent in the next message.
msg_recent: 📚 Your recent articles (tap to get again):
msg_welcome:
Hello! 👋
I find legal open-access copies of scientific articles. Send a DOI, a title, an author name or an article link.
password_rule: At least 10 characters, not digits only.
prompt_author: Send the author name (e.g. Geoffrey Hinton):
prompt_query: Send the article title, DOI or link:

set_admin_bale_id_help: One or more numeric IDs (comma separated) that get the in-bot admin panel. Send /myid to the bot to see yours.

set_require_explicit_license_help: When on, copies without licence metadata are not downloaded.
set_temp_retention_hours_help: Unsaved files are deleted after this time.

sources_intro: Legal open-access sources. A lower priority number is preferred first.
token_help: Get the token from @botfather in Bale. It is stored in .env and never shown again.
